# A ringed planet in the sky: a faceted ball r 1.3 with a darker band, a thin tilted ring.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Planet --base-color 0.600 0.459 0.467 --no-slot
material new Band --base-color 0.506 0.384 0.443 --no-slot
material new Ring --base-color 0.765 0.639 0.541 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Planet --subdivisions 2 --radius 1.3 --location 0 0 0
material assign Planet
active Planet
mode edit
select face where "abs(pos.z - 0.25) < 0.28"
material assign Band
mode object
add mesh torus --name Ring --major-segments 16 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 2.1 --minor-radius 0.16
scale 1 1 0.3
apply --scale
set rotation 12 -20 0
material assign Ring
select all
shade flat
export planet.glb
